Shivam vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Dept. Of ... on 19 May,
2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:35291
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1104 of 2022
Applicant :- Shivam

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Dept. Of Home And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar Trivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Dharmendra Kumar Trivedi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Kumar
Dwivedi, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
400 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. Section 3 (2) (V) of Sc/St Act and Section 5/6 of
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Salon, District
Raebareli.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 18.10.2021 stating that
at about 1.30 p.m. on 16.10.2021, the applicant enticed away the informant's minor daughter aged
about 17 years.
4.  In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that she knows the applicant for the past twenty days and he had raped her inside a tube well.
5. Before the doctor who conducted her medico legal examination, the victim gave a similar statement.
6. In the radiological examination, the age of the victim has been opined to be about 18 years.

sentences.text: 7. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she reiterated her earlier version.

8. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
9. The State has filed a counter affidavit disclosing an another case involving the allegation of commission of rape by the applicant.

10. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has already been granted bail by this court in the other case in which he is involved in Case Crime No.499 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 342, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Salon, District Raebareli.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 11. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that the offence is heinous in nature, as such, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

12. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the allegations levelled in the F.I.R. of commission of rape by the applicant is fully supported by the statement of the victim recorded by the Investigating Officer, her statement given before the doctor who conducted her medico legal examination and the statement given before the Magistrate,
coupled with the fact that the applicant is involved in another case of similar nature and he has given effect to the incident while he was on bail in earlier offence, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts do not warrant exercise of discretion of this court by enlarging the applicant on bail.
13. Accordingly, this bail application stands rejected.

Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Ram.
